title: Render Metrics graphs as SVG images
summary: Updates the Metrics page chart renderer so remux/encode, storage, production, and worker graphs produce accessible SVG image output instead of only CSS span bars.
reason: Metrics graphs were visible as styled DOM bars but did not produce an image primitive that can be captured or inspected as a graph image.
behavior_before: Metrics graph rows were rendered with span-based CSS tracks and fills.
behavior_after: Metrics graph rows render inline SVG images with accessible labels, tone-specific fills, and the same surrounding metric labels and values.
manual_validation: Chrome DevTools screenshot proof passed: artifacts/metrics-graphs-proof.png captured 16 Metrics SVG chart images
rollback_plan: Restore the Metrics renderer to span-based CSS chart bars and remove the SVG-specific CSS/test assertions.
notes: No backend media policy or source/scratch/output mutation behavior changed.
